scenes.title: A boat and a warning
scenes.summary: Sela Thorn agrees to row the party for two silver, refuses night travel, and offers a first-light departure tomorrow. She says Saltmere flooded when the bell first rang forty years ago and relays her grandmother's account of warm water.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in the mine
scenes.summary: The party finds warm black floodwater and hymn-book pages, including one marked "M. Brand" that Teo identifies as Mira's handwriting. Vessa and Oren suspect Maren's involvement; the search yields nothing else, and Oren takes two damage from bad air.

scenes.title: The bell beneath the water
scenes.summary: A fisherman warns that the Kelp Mother takes children near the water. At midnight the underwater bell rings twelve times, louder humming accompanies pale figures in rows on the chapel floor, and the party leaves after the figures vanish.

scenes.title: Tomorrow's dive
scenes.summary: The party plans to take Sela's boat at first light and dive to the chapel at daytime low tide; Vessa plans to buy rope and a second lantern. Bram says Maren lost a brother to the bay, and the party takes a long rest.
